piece.text: My offer won't sit on the table forever.

piece.text: I'd hate for somebody else to get this call first.

piece.text: {name} has been working the members on {bill}. Now it's your turn, in a room with the door shut.

piece.text: {bill} comes up soon, and {name} has a reason to want you on the right side of it. {name} asks to see you where no one can hear.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} asks for a minute in private. It's about the contract, and it isn't about the paperwork.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} is waiting outside your office. The contract is all {name} has talked about for weeks.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I've heard that line before. It didn't sound right then, either.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: If everybody does it, they can do it without me.

piece.text: I've been threatened by better. Take it back.

piece.text: Try. I'm still not taking it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You can't scare me into taking money.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Call it a thank-you if you like. I'm not keeping it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: A thank-you is a card. This is not a card.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. You made your point. Leave it on the desk.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Everybody does it, you say. Then nobody will notice.

piece.text: You've made yourself clear. I'll keep it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Nobody needs to threaten anybody. I'll take it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I gave you a way out. Now I'm making the call.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Keep talking. It makes my report easier.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's a second thing I'm putting in my report.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Say that again in front of the ethics office.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Then you won't mind explaining it to the ethics office.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Nobody says thank you like this. I'm reporting it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I won't listen to any more of this. Take it and go.

piece.text: Go. I mean it.

piece.text: We're finished. Please go.

piece.text: Show yourself out.

piece.text: Thank me some other way. I have to go.

piece.text: I won't stand here and pretend this is anything else.

piece.text: I gave it real thought. The answer is no.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Still no. I'd rather you hear it from me than from someone else.

piece.text: You're right, and I'm sorry. I never meant any of it.

piece.text: I let it ride. That was wrong of me.

piece.text: Believe whoever you want.

piece.text: Who told you that doesn't change what I do next.

piece.text: Whoever said that wasn't in the room.

piece.text: I never said any such thing.

piece.text: You let me think we understood each other. Why?

piece.text: Did it ever cross your mind to just tell me no?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fine. I'll take it back, and you forget I came.

piece.text: All right. Neither of us says a word about this.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Don't dodge me. Yes or no?

piece.text: That isn't an answer, and you know it.

piece.text: Good. You won't regret this.

piece.text: I appreciate it more than I can say.

piece.text: I'll be in touch. Keep an eye on the news.

piece.text: When it's finished, you'll know. I'll see to it.

piece.text: Fine. I'll find another way.

piece.text: Understood. I won't bring it up again.

piece.text: Sleep on it. You know where to find me.

piece.text: I'll check back with you. Take your time, but not too much of it.

piece.text: {bill} is going to cost me, and I remember who stood by me, {first}. Think about that.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I don't ask twice, {first}. {bill} is the reason I'm here.

piece.text: I've bid on this town's work for years, {first}. Don't make me remember this.

piece.text: That contract was supposed to be mine, {first}. People who cross me run short of friends.

piece.text: I've said all I'm going to say.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Enough. Please leave.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Have it your way. Forget I said anything.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I was only thinking out loud.

piece.text: Then we're finished here.

piece.text: Then I'll show myself out.

piece.text: Don't say I never gave you a chance.

piece.text: Think hard about who calls you next.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Good. I'm glad we got there.

piece.text: Glad we agree.

piece.text: Thanks. I'll keep that in mind.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Appreciate you telling me straight.

piece.text: Easy to say in a hallway. I'll be watching the board.

piece.text: And if it comes down to one vote?

piece.text: All right, I got you. Another time.

piece.text: Okay. I won't push.

piece.text: Can I grab you for a second?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Excuse me. One question.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thanks for stopping.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Appreciate it. That clears it up.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Is that on the record?

piece.text: Can I put your name on that?

piece.text: All right. I'll note that you passed.

piece.text: No problem. I'll try you again later.

piece.text: Do you have a minute? I'll be quick.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Glad I caught you. A word?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thank you. That's useful to hear.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I appreciate your time.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: A lot of people are counting on this one.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Our members are watching how you vote.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I hear you. Thanks for being straight with me.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fair. I'll take it back to my people.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thank you. That means a lot to this campaign.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You just made my week. Thank you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You won't regret this. I'll earn it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll work for every vote, yours included.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I respect that. Thanks for the straight answer.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fair enough. I'll keep working.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Then I'll have to earn it from your neighbors.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's your call. I'll keep going door to door.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Take a few days. I'll check back.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: No rush, but the clock is running.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Decide soon, please. This could come down to a few hundred votes.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'd hate for it to be close and know I didn't ask you twice.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: No problem. Thanks for the time.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Safe travels. Thanks for stopping by.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Sure thing. Have a good one.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. Thanks for listening.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Remember who paid for the signs.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I didn't give that much to be ignored.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Remember this when you ask me for the next check.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Don't expect the next one to come easy.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} gave {money} to your campaign. Now {name} wants to talk about what that bought.

piece.text: {name} is one of the people who paid for your race, {money} of it, and arrives with a request.

piece.text: I stood behind you when it counted. Now I need you on {bill}.

piece.text: I don't ask for much. {bill} is the one thing I'm asking for.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fine. A meeting, nothing more. Call my office.

piece.text: That I can do. Let's find a time.

piece.text: I'll look at it if you'll look at my side too.

piece.text: {source} says nobody has heard a word from you on it.

piece.text: That's what I wanted to hear. Thanks.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Glad to hear it. I'll let my people know.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'd check who's talking before I believed it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's not the whole story.

piece.text: {source} wasn't in the room.

piece.text: Whatever {source} told you, it isn't what I said.

piece.text: I understand. I'll look elsewhere.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's disappointing, but I'll live.

piece.text: That means a lot. Thank you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I won't forget it. Thank you.

piece.text: Glad you came around.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thank you. I know what that cost you.

piece.text: That's fair. I'll send you the details.

piece.text: That's more than I expected.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Nothing I can get into. Excuse me.

piece.text: That's all I'm going to say about it.

piece.text: Let me see the numbers first.

piece.text: Give me a few days. I need to count noses.

piece.text: Wrong about what, exactly?

piece.text: Did you raise it or didn't you?

piece.text: Ask {source} who they're working for.

piece.text: I'd look hard at {source}'s reasons.

piece.text: I'm not discussing this.

piece.text: That's enough of that.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll ask them, then.

piece.text: Noted.
